questions.topic: DAMS · CT Surgery Gen uro FMGE CT
questions.stem: A 55-year-old shipyard worker is referred by his general practitioner (GP) to the Ear, Nose, and Throat (ENT) clinic for a lump in the anterior triangle of his neck. The firm 2 cm by 2 cm mass seems to be fixed to the underlying tissue and moves with swallowing but not with tongue protrusion. Which of the following is true of fine-needle aspiration (FNA) of this lesion?

options.label: A
options.text: A FNA sample containing colloid is suggestive of malignancy

options.label: B
options.text: A FNA sample containing follicular cells is suggestive of malignancy

options.label: C
options.text: FNA is useful in the diagnosis of papillary carcinoma

options.label: D
options.text: FNA is useful in the exclusion of follicular malignancy
